title: Five pages stopped butting up against the sidebar - the gutter is padding now

text: A page's padding used to be two empty columns of its grid, so any rule that replaced the grid deleted it without a word. That is what put the Styles title flat against the sidebar on a wide screen. It is real padding now, which nothing can replace. Measured across 133 pages at four widths: the pages with text on the edge went from six to one, and the one left asks for zero on purpose.
